Lufus - bootable media creator

Usage:
  lufus                         Open the graphical interface
  lufus list [--all]            List eligible target devices
  lufus checksum --image PATH   Calculate image checksums
  lufus probe --image PATH      Inspect ISO capabilities without mounting
  lufus download [OPTIONS]      Discover/download official Microsoft or UEFI Shell ISOs
  lufus write [OPTIONS]         Write a raw image or Windows installer
  lufus test-device [OPTIONS]   Destructively test real capacity and blocks
  lufus capture [OPTIONS]       Save a device as raw, VHD, or VHDX
  lufus --version               Show the version

Run 'lufus COMMAND --help' for command-specific options.
{"is_iso": true, "has_efi": true, "has_windows": false, "supports_windows_installer": false, "supports_windows_to_go": false, "supports_persistence": true}
